_doc: PPIR infield pavement, edge-measured off NAIP 2023 0.3 m (ledger 0085 Re-trace; retrace.py, pieces.py). ENU metres about tracks/pikes-peak/data/centerline.local.json's origin, NAIP registration removed (registration.json). Each piece's direction is its via order; 'left'/'right' face that direction. edge_en_m every 1 m between its first and last seen edge point; centre_en_m and width every 1 m.

ne_lane.description: the lane off the back stretch, oval diverge to the hairpin top (newest pavement)

hairpin_w.description: the hairpin's west leg, down island B's west side to the C road junction

diag_n.description: the wide road south-east from the C junction to the parallel lane's mouth

diag_s.description: the wide road on south-east to the lot's north end

n_road.description: the road inside the grass lens, NW oval junction to the hairpin top

arc_nw.description: the kerbed sweeper, the oval's inside at the NW junction to the west road's top

c_road.description: the C road, the west road's top to the C junction (the S-curve's north mouth opens off it)

west_n.description: the west road, its top junction to the S-curve's west mouth

bottom.description: the west road on south, round the SW bend and east along the bottom to the lot's west side

s_curve.description: the older S-curve, C road mouth down, round its hairpin, west to the west road

par_lane.description: the narrow parallel lane, the diag road east and south-east to the lot ring's north-east corner

ring_nw.description: the lot ring's north-west side, the bottom road's mouth to the diag road's (clockwise)

ring_ne.description: the lot ring's north-east side (the diag road continued) past the parallel lane's mouth to the east side

ring_s.description: the lot ring's east, south and west sides, round to the bottom road's mouth
